visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black graphic T-shirt and glasses stands next to a young girl with pigtails in a pink shirt. They are in a modern white kitchen with bright studio lighting. The man is showing her an egg carton on the white counter. (2) The man demonstrates cracking an egg into a white ceramic bowl. He uses both hands to pull the shell apart while the girl watches intently with her hands resting on the countertop near the bowl. (3) The girl picks up an egg and taps it against the rim of the bowl. She successfully cracks the shell and pours the contents inside, looking focused as her father watches closely and provides silent encouragement. (4) The camera zooms in on the girl's hands as she uses wooden chopsticks to stir the eggs in the bowl. She moves them in a vigorous circular motion, creating a uniform yellow mixture. (5) The girl reaches towards the black glass stovetop and turns a silver knob. A ring of blue gas flames ignites under a black frying pan already placed on the burner. (6) The girl holds a large dark green glass bottle of oil and carefully pours a small amount into the center of the pan. The father stands nearby in the background, observing her progress. (7) The girl lifts the white bowl containing the beaten eggs and slowly pours the liquid into the heated frying pan. The yellow liquid immediately begins to set and bubble as it hits the hot surface. (8) Holding a white spatula, the girl scrambles the eggs in the pan. The man stands behind her, cheering and mimicking a fast stirring motion with his arms to encourage her to move the spatula quickly. (9) The girl picks up a glass salt grinder and shakes it over the pan. She uses both hands to twist and shake the container, ensuring a light seasoning is spread across the cooking eggs. (10) The girl carefully uses the spatula to slide the finished scrambled eggs from the pan onto a beige ceramic plate. She looks proud of her accomplishment as she completes the transfer. (11) The girl holds the plate of fluffy scrambled eggs towards the camera with a big smile on her face. She stands in the middle of the kitchen, presenting her work clearly. (12) Seated at a wooden dining table, the girl uses a fork to take a large bite of the eggs. She chews with satisfaction, looking directly at the camera while the father is partially visible in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a heartwarming family moment where a father teaches his young daughter how to cook scrambled eggs for the first time. The video focuses on the child's learning process, her success, and the subsequent enjoyment of the meal.
